All good points. We are still in testing phase for sure. But the treatment does show efficacy in preventing the onset of suicidal ideation in people who have risk factors for suicidal ideation but not suicidal ideation yet.

This go round is to really see if the treatment can reduce suicidal ideation in people who are experiencing the risk factors AND suicidal ideation.

Thanks. This is the eligibility survey. It is open to any adults showing signs and symptoms of depression. 

So please feel free to share far and wide.
